checkpoints.original: before=BV & RCV LabBiological variation, analytical performance specifications derived from it, and reference change values for interpreting serial results. This is an educational reasoning pathway — Understand variation → Identify CVA/CVI/CVG → Check data provenance → Assess individuality → Derive BV-based APS → Select an RCV model → Interpret serial change → State limitations — not a rigid universal sequence.Understand variation→Identify CVA/CVI/CVG→Check data provenance→Assess individuality→Derive BV-based APS→Select an RCV model→Interpret serial change→State limitationsThis is an educational reasoning pathway, not a rigid universal sequence — real interpretation of serial results may revisit earlier steps as new evidence (a repeat result, a preanalytical explanation, a provenance check) emerges.Every result you have ever produced already has some natural wobble built in — even in a perfectly healthy, perfectly stable person, tested with a perfect instrument.
